## Page and audience

Link the exact page/section and say who is trying to use it.

## What is unclear or inaccurate?

Include the expected explanation and any supporting source or dated evidence.
Do not include private data or security details; use SECURITY.md for vulnerabilities.

## Suggested correction and acceptance

How will we know a first-time reader can follow the corrected guidance?
Do not repeat hardware operations solely to reproduce a documentation issue.

## Ownership or related work

Link an existing issue/PR or workplan entry if relevant. Leave unknown owners
unassigned rather than guessing a reviewer.
